meta.title: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You?
meta.description: If you lived as a fairy-tale hero, who would you be? Twelve scenes reveal your fairy-tale character and dating style.

startMessage.line1: If you lived as a fairy-tale hero, who would you be?
startMessage.line2: Someone who shines through waiting, someone who flies free, someone brave enough to love. Fairy-tale heroes each love in their own way. The story that pulls you in holds the texture of how you love.
startMessage.line3: Pick the reaction that feels most like you across twelve scenes. We'll show your fairy-tale hero and dating style—and read every result as a strength.

questions.q: They've gone quiet while you're still talking stage. You:
opts: Set the worry aside and focus on what makes you happy
Trust they're a good person and ask friends what they think
Wonder if something deeper is going on behind the silence
Reach out first and suggest meeting up

questions.q: A rough stretch just won't end. You:
opts: Believe better days will come and quietly keep going
Keep the hard feelings inside and hold on for what matters
Try a new path and look for a way through
Lean on people around you and get back on your feet

questions.q: Someone you like is acting cold. You:
opts: Figure there must be a reason and stay nearby watching
Keep doing your part faithfully beside them and wait
Don't overthink it and keep things light
Want to share how you feel but hesitate over the words

questions.q: Picking a spot for a first date. You:
opts: Suggest exploring somewhere you've never been
Pick somewhere fun like an amusement park
Choose a quiet place by the sea or a lake where feelings stir
Choose a cozy spot where they can open up comfortably

questions.q: Your partner doesn't get how you feel. You:
opts: Try to show your heart through actions instead of words
Stay by their side until your hearts finally click, even if it takes time
Keep showing care, trusting they'll understand someday
Believe honesty will get through and talk it out

questions.q: Responsibility in the relationship suddenly grows. You:
opts: Want to put it off—freedom still feels good right now
Feel scared but step forward and face it head-on
Talk it through with people you trust and get through it together
Prepare calmly and take ownership of your part

questions.q: You notice your partner's flaws. You:
opts: Look at the good side first and try to trust them
Quietly care while making room for the flaws too
Ask about what you're curious about right away
Find them fun as they are and brush it off lightly

questions.q: An important promise gets broken. You:
opts: Feel hurt but gather yourself and wait for the next chance
Calmly listen to why and try to understand their side
Vent to someone you trust and let yourself be comforted
Want to work it out in person, so you go find them

questions.q: You're being introduced to someone new. You:
opts: Feel full of curiosity and strike up conversation first
Prepare neatly and talk calmly
Lighten the mood with a playful joke
Watch carefully and open up slowly

questions.q: If love meant giving something up, you would:
opts: Gladly give up your own thing for someone precious
Look for a way to help each other and solve it together
Choose protecting what's real over appearances
Look for a happier path instead of giving something up

questions.q: After a fight, how do you make up? You:
opts: Listen until you understand what's really going on for them
Go to them first, apologize honestly, and try to work it out
Say little, but show your heart through small actions
Give it time and wait for a calm chance to talk again

questions.q: Which line feels closest to your dating philosophy right now?
opts: "Trust people and open your heart—good things follow"
"Love should stay fun and free if it's going to last"
"Wait kindly and the right person will come"
"Look past the surface and real love shows up"

results.title: Someone who quietly keeps kindness until their moment arrives, Cinderella 👠
results.realReason: Someone who quietly keeps kindness until their moment arrives
results.shortDescription: You're someone who doesn't lose hope or dignity even in hard times.
results.description: Dating style: You build feelings steadily and keep showing care until the right connection comes.
results.strengths: The moment hearts finally meet after waiting
results.reasonDetail: Not only waiting—taking one step forward yourself
results.frequentSaying: "A kind heart eventually opens the way"
results.changeTips: Find the courage to send a small signal first
results.oneLiner: The power of waiting is real. One line you offer first can bring your moment sooner
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? Cinderella 👠 I'm Cinderella lol—kindness opens the path. Who are you?

results.title: Someone who flies free and light, Peter Pan 🧚
results.realReason: Someone who flies free and light
results.shortDescription: With you around, everyday life feels light like an adventure.
results.description: Dating style: You meet without tying each other down and make the moments together feel fun.
results.strengths: Trips you take together, moments when the mood dips
results.reasonDetail: Not brushing off conversations that need responsibility
results.frequentSaying: "Let's fly and have fun today too"
results.changeTips: Keep promises and replies—even lightly, but keep them
results.oneLiner: Free-spirited energy is charming. Carve the important promises into your heart
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? Peter Pan 🧚 I'm Peter Pan lol—flying free. Who are you?

results.title: Someone who finds big courage for love, The Little Mermaid 🧜
results.realReason: Someone who finds big courage for love
results.shortDescription: You love deeply enough to put your whole heart on the line.
results.description: Dating style: You gladly pour heart and effort into someone precious.
results.strengths: Confessions that hand over the heart, moments you step forward for them
results.reasonDetail: Sharing the feelings you couldn't say, one line at a time, so they don't become misunderstandings
results.frequentSaying: "I love you with all my heart"
results.changeTips: Offer your heart in words, not only in actions
results.oneLiner: Devotion is powerful. Make sure your own heart gets heard too
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? The Little Mermaid 🧜 I'm the Little Mermaid haha—loves with the whole heart. Who are you?

results.title: Someone who trusts purely and rises together, Snow White 🍎
results.realReason: Someone who trusts purely and rises together
results.shortDescription: Your clear trust in people warms everyone around you.
results.description: Dating style: You see the good in them first and grow the relationship with the people by your side.
results.strengths: New meetings, moments you share your heart when things get hard
results.reasonDetail: Balancing trust with checking the facts once
results.changeTips: Alongside kindness, ask "I'm curious about this part" to check in
results.oneLiner: Pure trust is a big gift. One checking question makes it safer
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? Snow White 🍎 I'm Snow White haha—trust gathers people. Who are you?

results.title: Someone who sees past the surface and opens hearts, Beauty and the Beast 🌹
results.realReason: Someone who sees past the surface and opens hearts
results.shortDescription: You recognize who someone really is and help change unfold.
results.description: Dating style: Even if it takes time, you understand what's inside and build deep trust.
results.strengths: Moments a closed heart softens, moments you finally understand each other
results.reasonDetail: Keeping your own boundaries instead of only trying to change them
results.changeTips: Ask for what you want in words as much as you understand them
results.oneLiner: Deep understanding is powerful. Care for your own heart with the same weight
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? Beauty and the Beast 🌹 I'm Beauty and the Beast haha—sees the real you. Who are you?

results.title: Someone brave enough to set out on curiosity alone, Little Red Riding Hood 🧺
results.realReason: Someone brave enough to set out on curiosity alone
results.shortDescription: You're someone with the courage to walk first toward what you're curious about.
results.description: Dating style: You speak first and learn the relationship by facing it directly.
results.keywords: curiosity, grit, flexibility learned from experience
results.strengths: New meetings, moments you go fix conflict yourself
results.reasonDetail: When opening up to someone new, check first and get closer slowly
results.changeTips: Approach first—but watch whether their words and actions match
results.oneLiner: Courage is a big asset. Take new connections one safe step at a time
results.shareLine: Which Fairy-Tale Hero Are You? Little Red Riding Hood 🧺 I'm Little Red Riding Hood lol—walks first when curious. Who are you?
